name: Taiga
long_description:
Taiga automates medical billing for doctor's offices. A doctor uploads their visit data, our AI figures out the right billing codes, checks the claim for errors, and submits it to insurance, dealing with any denials. Faster billing, fewer rejected claims, less busywork.                                                       
                                                                                                                        
We're Nanda and Adam, friends since 3rd grade. Both of our parents are doctors with their own practices, and billing was always a source of stress and lost revenue for them. We want providers to treat patients while we handle the rest.

founders.title: Founder/CEO

launches.title: Taiga: AI-native medical billing for modern practices
launches.tagline: You treat the patient, we handle the rest.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋 We're Adam and Nanda, the founders of **Taiga**.

**tl;dr:**

We automate the entire medical billing process for independent doctor's offices from coding to claim submission to denial management.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HzQ13iVhbxk>

**❌ The Problem**

If you've ever talked to an independent doctor about billing, you know it's a nightmare.

* Independent practices either hire expensive billing staff, outsource to clunky billing companies, or doctors do it themselves after hours
* Claims get rejected for coding errors that could have been caught
* Denials pile up unfollowed, and revenue leaks everywhere

**🌲 How Taiga Works**

We automate the entire process.

* **Prior auths + benefits checks** — We check out the patient’s insurance before they come in to make billing seamless
* **EMR Integration** — We pull visit data automatically as soon as the visit completes
* **AI-Powered Coding & Scrubbing** — Our AI agents review clinician notes and generate procedure and diagnosis codes that are strongly supported
* **Claim Submission** — We submit clean claims directly to insurance
* **Denial Management** — We fight every single denial until the clinic gets paid. Every. Single. One.

**🧾 Proof**

> Taiga has been exceptionally easy to work with, with a responsive team always available to provide support. They successfully secured payment on a previously rejected claim by resolving an issue that had persisted for months; and they were able to accomplish that in just over a weeks time.

\- Neal Cheskis, LCSW

\
**👫 Why Us**

Both of our parents are doctors with their own practices. We watched billing cause them stress and lost revenue our entire lives. With our background in tech and our deep emotional ties to the space, we are able to provide faster payments and cheaper service so clinicians can focus on what’s important.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100548&key=user_uploads/2909293/ba095169-9bac-4f96-97ab-753de18e4288)

**Talk to us!**

If you're a doctor or know a doctor, we'd love to talk. Visit [taigabilling.com](https://taigabilling.com)!
